The Aerial Lift Bridge is a Minnesota landmark that connects Duluth's port to the rest of the world.

I joined Mayor Reinert and local leaders in Duluth from labor and business to highlight federal funding we worked to secure that will restore this iconic bridge and preserve it for generations to come.

posts.text:
Today marks 500 days of Donald Trump's presidency.

In that time, he's launched a war with Iran that has caused gas prices to skyrocket, imposed tariffs that raised costs, and made life more expensive.

This November, voters will be able to put a check on this guy and finally start turning the page.
